title: Customer Experience
desc: Handle orders, feedback, and relationships across LINE, phone, and in-branch with warmth and efficiency.
responsibilities: Respond to customer inquiries on LINE and phone. Process orders and coordinate with kitchen and delivery. Handle feedback and resolve issues with care. Assist at pop-ups and events.
requirements: Warm, professional communication style. Comfortable with LINE and basic order systems. Thai fluency required, English is a plus. Previous service experience preferred.
benefits: Birthday cake, flexible hours, team events
